docs/OCOR_LLD_v1.1.md:36-40 urn:sha256 digests, sorted duplicate-free sets, recalculated digests fail closed; immutable pins and idempotent invocation

ambiguities_resolved_fail_closed: the norm fixes no registry reason codes: a closed set drawn from the normative vocabulary (SCHEMA_VIOLATION, CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND, CONTRACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH, CONTRACT_REJECTED, RELEASE_MISMATCH, GOVERNED_CONTEXT_MISMATCH, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE, UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY, EXECUTION_FAILED)

a READ_CANONICAL/READ_PROJECTION/READ_EXTERNAL Function is published but its invocation is UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: the sandbox has no governed read port, so the served commit and watermark (NFR-024) could not be disclosed
registry digests use the internal urn:sha256 form of LLD v1.1 :36; conversion to a wire form belongs to a transport adapter (as NCR-C2-008 option 2 for the gateway)
ModelDescriptor has no output kind field: the signed manifest declares PREDICTION, BELIEF or RECOMMENDATION, otherwise publication is rejected
InvocationContext.ontology_release_digest must equal the ir_digest of the C1 release the entry was bound to at publication (RELEASE_MISMATCH otherwise)
ModelDescriptor has no budget: the ModelRegistry runs models under a configured ResourceBudget

publication binds the pin to a named contract of kind FUNCTION or MODEL_FUNCTION of an admitted C1 release: version, contract digest (RFC 8785 of the contract), effect class, input/output schema digests, policy refs (Functions) and risk class (Models) must match
a pin is immutable: a different descriptor under the same exact pin is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

ResourceBudget quotas are proto uint64 but every signed object is RFC 8785 JSON (LLD v1.1 :36), whose numbers are binary64: a quota above 2**53 - 1 is rejected with SCHEMA_VIOLATION (the bound of c1/ir.py), and a timeout above the Duration range (315576000000 s) likewise

ModelDescriptor has a single artifact_signature_ref: the signed manifest names the DSSE artefact signatures of the deployment and of the mapping (deployment_signature_ref, mapping_signature_ref); a manifest without them is CONTRACT_REJECTED

'fuori release' for a deployment or mapping: its pin carries the contract_digest and semantic_version of the Model contract of the admitted release (CONTRACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH / RELEASE_MISMATCH otherwise), the most restrictive reading
the memory quota is the absolute RLIMIT_AS of the sandboxed process; a quota that the started interpreter already exceeds is an audited MEMORY overrun, not an execution failure
a DSSE envelope with any malformed signature entry is rejected even when another entry verifies

change_anchors.change: new: the ocor.registry.v1 enums and the 19 messages field by field
new: exact pins only, range/latest rejected with SCHEMA_VIOLATION
new: FR-058 mandatory metadata and NFR-025 positive budget, UNSPECIFIED and MODEL_INFERENCE rejected for Functions
new: MODEL_INFERENCE only; every FR-060 field mandatory
new: TypedValue schema and type URL equal to the pinned descriptor
new: exactly one disposition, declared output kind, no output outside the envelope
new: closed canonical mapping (RFC 8785) of messages; extra, missing or ill-typed fields rejected
new: the FunctionRegistry operations with signed manifest, artefact signature, release binding, revocation, context binding, idempotency
new: the ModelRegistry operations, validity envelope abstention, lineage and replay
new: DSSE (Ed25519 profile of C1) statements for descriptors and artefacts under the trust root
new: isolated interpreter under RLIMIT_CPU/AS/FSIZE/CORE/NPROC and NOFILE, wall timeout, output cap; overruns raise SandboxOverrun
new: append-only hash-linked entries and audit, content-addressed artefacts, revocations and invocation lineage on PostgreSQL

preventive review P1: the stored entry record is rebuilt from the signed manifest, signatures, revocations and the re-admitted release on every resolve and invoke and must equal the stored one; malformed stored data is a typed error
preventive review P1: provenance and result digests recalculated and output re-validated before replay; stored lineage shape-checked before reconstruction

preventive review P3: deployment and mapping DSSE artefact signatures named by the signed manifest, verified and revocation-checked; deployment and mapping bound to the Model contract of the admitted release; release_ref and output_kind type-checked
preventive review P5: every DSSE envelope and signature entry field type-checked before use; an invalid pinned JSON Schema is a typed rejection

preventive review P4: memory quota applied by the runner after start (quota below the started interpreter is a MEMORY overrun; reserve to report the artefact overrun); limits clamped to host hard limits; budget re-admitted; start failures typed
preventive review P4/P5: quotas at most 2**53 - 1 and Duration at most 315576000000 s; bounded Duration decoding; non-string member names and non-text base64 rejected

preventive review P2: every column of every row type-checked without coercion; connection-level driver errors CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE, every other driver or decoding error and malformed row CONTRACT_REJECTED

change_anchors_note: the unit only adds the package ocor_runtime.registry; no existing module, caller, test, contract or schema changes
